name: Syral Bladeleaf
summary: In Dolanaar, Syral Bladeleaf guides night elves arriving from Shadowglen. As a resident of Teldrassil, she speaks for the Council of the Forest and directs them to local caretakers, herbalists, and elders who watch over the crown's boughs.

sections.title: A Voice in Dolanaar
sections.body: Syral Bladeleaf helps direct new arrivals through Dolanaar beneath Teldrassil's canopy. She speaks for the Council of the Forest, sending night elves to community leaders and herbalists in the village and nearby wilderness. Her guidance leads travelers to Denalan, a botanist at Lake Al'Ameth, and helps them replenish supplies for the village elders.

sections.title: Ties to the Village
sections.body: In Dolanaar, Syral carries out the Council of the Forest's work for the village. She helps see that medicinal elixirs reach those in need and that disruptions to the local ecosystem receive swift attention.

faq.answer: Syral Bladeleaf is a night elf in Dolanaar who conveys the Council of the Forest's directives and helps newcomers assist woodland communities.

faq.q: Where can Syral Bladeleaf be found?
faq.answer: Syral Bladeleaf can be found in Dolanaar, Teldrassil's central settlement, just southwest of Shadowglen along the main road.

faq.q: What tasks does she assign to adventurers?
faq.answer: Syral sends travelers to help Denalan, the botanist at Lake Al'Ameth, arrange herbal elixirs for the elders, and aid Teldrassil's natural balance.

angles.text: As a young night elf leaving Shadowglen's secluded barrows, you meet one of Dolanaar's first voices of civic and natural leadership in Syral Bladeleaf.
As an herbalist, you can help Syral direct travelers to Denalan's botanical research at Lake Al'Ameth and see that fresh elixirs reach the elders.
